title: Finite time-anchored Fibonacci drawings during horizontal chart panning
changes: Fib horizontal levels have a finite, saved UTC endTime captured at the moment of placement; no current-viewport right-edge or 1800px infinite extension.
Fib level captions use the same transformed drawing layer and finite X endpoint, not fixed right-edge text that respawns during chart panning.
Existing saved Fibonacci drawings without fibEndTime use a deterministic finite legacy span from their original anchor timestamps.
Whole-Fib drag translates saved endTime together with anchors, preserving drawing length.
Retain original Fibonacci prices, level colors, 0 dot hit target, delete/undo, rectangles, risk/reward positions, indicators, 1D/4H history and price WebSocket unchanged.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite four MultiAssetLiquidityRadar files on GitHub Pages; no Cloudflare Worker change required.
validationNote: Isolated browser geometry/pan tests; existing historical Fib endpoint can only be approximated because prior releases did not store it.
